finalText:
**Build's clean now — exit 0, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) — new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`, code still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashed on `.toFixed()`. Now reads `retryCount`.
2. [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only accepted `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Now treats anything not `true` as disabled.

The rest of the "screen full of warnings" is just deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) baked into the bump — not blocking the build.

Next: nothing.
